No LLM-as-judge evaluation was conducted in this paper (published before widespread LLM evaluation practices).

overall_notes: The paper focuses on cross-lingual summarization using a novel ATS (Attend, Translate, Summarize) method. Evaluation includes both automatic metrics (ROUGE, MoverScore) and human evaluation on quality dimensions. The metadata extraction was generally accurate with minor normalization needed for metric variants and model naming consistency.
